name: OFBench
description: A benchmark suite of enterprise application workloads and metrics for evaluating cloud resource management algorithms (e.g., allocation, scaling, scheduling).
reputation: A scholarly benchmark suite referenced in cloud resource management research, used in academic evaluations though not as widely standardized as large industry benchmarks.
notes: Designed for enterprise application workloads (2012); contains synthetic and realistic workloads, is not an LLM benchmark, and results can be sensitive to simulator/configuration differences and hardware variability.
